key_findings: The official Fresenius master's landing page lists five new study programs; all five were read from official programme pages.
Fresenius English-language programmes use CEFR B2 English as the common standard; the central admissions page gives TOEFL iBT 70 and IELTS 6.0 as examples.
SAP Engineering & Analytics has the most specific conditional route: 30 credit points in business, IT, or engineering modules can be replaced by a subject-related interview if missing.
The biomedical and chemistry-related programmes require a 180-credit bachelor's background in relevant life-science or chemistry-related fields.
No official GRE/GMAT requirement was found on the reviewed Fresenius programme pages.
known_gaps: The English master's landing page lists additional master programmes beyond the five new programmes reviewed here; those were not exhaustively converted in this worker pass.
Public programme pages did not expose application deadlines, exact intakes, fees, or complete document checklists in the fetched text.
Biochemical Engineering is listed as M.Eng. on the master landing and page title, while one admission sentence refers to M.Sc.; that record is marked for human review.
